exposure: Cardiac surgery with hypothermia during cardiopulmonary bypass
STAT mortality category of the surgical procedure
Type of cardiac malformation (e.g., dextro-transposition of the great arteries, univentricular anatomy)
outcome: Neurodevelopmental impairment (cognitive deficit, cerebral palsy, major neurosensory deficit)
cohort: A monocentric cohort of 24 very low birthweight (<1500 g) infants with severe congenital heart defect born between 2008 and 2017, who received cardiac surgery within 1 year after birth.
finding: Survival without neuro-developmental impairment at 2 years corrected age was 29.2% in the entire cohort, with the type of cardiac malformation affecting early- and long-term outcomes.
